rules.statement: An act of unlawful interference with the possession of property, under circumstances disclosing a real intention to intimidate or annoy the possessor, constitutes criminal trespass.
rules.supporting_quote: "When once an act of unlawful interference with the possession of property, under circumstances disclosing a real intention to intimidate or annoy the possessor, has been established, the offence of criminal trespass has been committed"
